data.title: Project Engineering Manager - Core Spreads Manufacturing
data.description:
Location: Pratau, Germany

On-site

About the position

As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice (by travelling) factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

You will:

  • Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
  • Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
  • Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
  • Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
  • Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
  • Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
  • Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
  • Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
  • Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
  • Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
  • Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
  • Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
  • Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
  • Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  

You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

What's Next? 

If this position sounds interesting, please hit the apply button now!

We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.  

Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.  

No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.

Intern Technology Consultant - Data & AI

Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Loki Query  | Germany | Remote
Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - EMEA
Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
data.description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

data.title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
data.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

What success looks like after your first year:

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Financial Oversight & Costing: Lead end-to-end project costing, budgeting, financial forecasting, PO management, and cost reconciliation across high-volume retainer scopes and bespoke campaign spikes.

data.title: Technical Lead, Laser Amplification (f/m/d)
data.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As Technical Lead, Laser Amplification, you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of the laser amplification subsystem. The amplification chain is the primary energy-scaling element of the laser system, so this role is central to translating ICF system requirements into an integrated, high-performing function.

You will define the subsystem architecture, establish the technical roadmap, lead design and test activities, manage interfaces and risks, and develop the team and capabilities needed to take the amplification chain from concept through hardware delivery and integration.


What you’ll do

  • Define and own the technical architecture for Main Amplifier systems from concept through design freeze, including topology, gain media, pump geometry, thermal management, ASE control, and interface specifications.

  • Ensure that the amplification architecture and development activities remain traceable to ICF system-level laser requirements.

  • Build and maintain the technical roadmap for Light Amplification, aligning development sequence, capability gaps, technology maturity, and program milestones.

  • Lead the design, build, characterization, and integration of the amplification chain.

  • Deliver subsystem performance to agreed specifications for energy, gain, beam quality, pulse contrast, and reliability.

  • Own the technical risk register, define mitigations and owners, and escalate risks early—before they become schedule or performance issues.

  • Define maturity gates for key amplification subsystems and technologies, and drive focused development activities to close demonstration gaps.

  • Own technical interfaces with adjacent functions, including Light Generation, Light Conditioning, Beam Transport, and Focusing.

  • Represent Light Amplification in system-level design reviews and communicate decisions, progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to technical and leadership audiences.

  • Build and develop the Amplification team by hiring engineers and scientists, setting clear expectations, providing feedback, and growing technical and leadership capability.

Who You Are

  • A PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, photonics, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience leading a technical team by setting direction, developing people, and maintaining effective communication across organizational boundaries.

  • Hands-on experience with high-energy or high-power laser amplification systems, including solid-state, fiber, or diode-pumped architectures.

  • Strong understanding of gain media physics, thermal effects, wavefront distortion, ASE, pulse contrast, and beam quality in amplifier chains.

  • Experience taking a laser subsystem from concept through hardware delivery, characterization, and integration.

  • The ability to own a technical scope, make decisions under uncertainty, and communicate clearly with both technical and leadership audiences.

  • Experience working in a matrix organization with shared resources and cross-functional dependencies.

  • A structured approach to requirements definition, traceability, risk management, root-cause analysis, and technical decision-making.

Nice to have

  • Experience in an ICF, high-power laser facility, or defense laser program.

  • Familiarity with amplification architectures.

  • Experience with diode-pumped solid-state amplifiers at the joule scale or more.

  • Experience with coaching, mentoring, performance management, hiring, onboarding, and team building.

  • Experience applying systems engineering and design-for-cost or design-for-manufacturing methods in a complex hardware program.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

data.title: Software Engineer (f/m/x)
data.description:
Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.

What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?

Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.

That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.


Why Tanso?

  • Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.
  • Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.
  • Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.
  • Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.
  • AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.
  • Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.


Your role

To take real ownership of what you build and take own end-to-end feature responsibility, we are looking for a Software Engineer (f/m/x). 

As a Software Engineer (m/f/x)  you will work on meaningful customer-facing problems within one of our platform modules and collaborate closely with product, design, customer success, and other engineers.

At Tanso, engineers are responsible understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, shaping the solution, making technical trade-offs, shipping to production, and iterating based on what we learn. We care less about following a predefined playbook and more about making good decisions, moving with purpose, and building software that creates tangible value for our customers.


Key responsibilities

  • Own customer-facing features from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Turn ambiguous requirements and user needs into pragmatic, maintainable solutions. Challenge assumptions and help decide what is worth building
  • Collaborate closely with product designers and customer success to understand user needs and shape effective solutions.
  • Contribute to the quality of our codebase, engineering practices, and developer experience.


Your profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software in Typescript.
  • Strong full-stack and product thinking, understanding systems end-to-end.
  • First experience with backend development, ideally with PostgreSQL and Azure.
  • Clear, precise communicator in English. 
  • Self-driven problem solver with strong ownership and execution mindset.
Nice to have
  • German language skills. 


What we offer

  • A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. 
  • Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. 
  • A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. 
  • Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. 
  • Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. 
  • Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. 


Our team

We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.

data.description:
Tätigkeitsbereich

Du verantwortest die Akquise institutioneller Kunden und Mandate mit Schwerpunkt Brown-to-Green im Bereich Residential. Dies beinhaltet Partnerschaften und Asset Management Mandate für die Transformation bestehender Portfolios, als auch Einwerbung institutionellen Eigenkapitals für unsere Immobilienstrategien – von Club Deals und Separate Accounts über Joint Ventures bis hin zu Fondsvehikeln. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Investoren, führst Gespräche eigenständig bis zum Abschluss und baust die Partner- und Kapitalseite unserer Plattform systematisch aus.


Dabei handelt es sich um keine reine Vertriebsrolle. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Transaktion, Asset Management und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übersetzt zwischen den Erwartungen der Investoren und operativer Realität.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Versorgungswerken, Pensionskassen, Versicherungen, Sparkassen, Stiftungen, Family Offices und Dachfonds

  • Eigenständige Ansprache, Qualifizierung und Betreuung von Investoren über den gesamten Zyklus – vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Investorenunterlagen: Teaser, Pitch Decks, Track-Record-Darstellungen, Investment Memoranda

  • Steuerung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen auf Investorenseite, inklusive Koordination von RfPs, DDQs und Datenraumanfragen

  • Verhandlung kommerzieller Eckpunkte (Fee-Strukturen, Co-Investment, Governance, Reporting-Anforderungen) in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Kontinuierliche Marktbeobachtung hinsichtlich: Allokationsverhalten, Wettbewerbsvehikel sowie regulatorische Entwicklungen (Solvency II, AnlV, KAGB)

  • Pflege der Investoren-Pipeline im CRM, belastbares Reporting an die Geschäftsführung

  • Repräsentation des Unternehmens auf Branchenveranstaltungen (Expo Real, MIPIM, Fachkonferenzen)


Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5–8 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Capital Raising, Investor Relations oder im institutionellen Vertrieb – zwingend mit klarem Immobilienbezug 

  • Belastbares, aktives Netzwerk zu deutschen institutionellen Investoren sowie nachweisbare eigene Abschlüsse

  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Immobilien-Kennzahlen und Strukturen (u.a IRR, Equity Multiple, Cash-on-Cash, Wasserfall, Leverage, Asset-Deal vs. Share-Deal) 

  • Fundierte Kenntnis der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen deutscher institutioneller Anleger 

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 

  • Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands

  • Wünschenswert: 

    • Erfahrung mit Value-Add- oder opportunistischen Strategien, nicht nur Core wäre wünschenswert

    • Vorerfahrung auf Investorenseite (z. B. Kapitalanlage, Immobilienreferate)

    • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen LPs oder Luxemburger Strukturen

    • Bestehende Beziehungen zu Platzierungsberatern und Consultants


Unsere Benefits, wir schaffen

  • Raum für Erholung: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr. Der 24. und 31. Dezember sind zusätzlich arbeitsfrei. Für besondere Ereignisse (wie Umzug) bekommst du weiteren Sonderurlaub.
  • Raum für Mobilität: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket und unterstützen dein JobRad, so kommst du nachhaltig und flexibel zur Arbeit.
  • Raum für Absicherung: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sorgen wir dafür, dass du langfristig gut abgesichert in die Zukunft blickst.
  • Raum für Ideen: Deine Meinung zählt! Wir fördern kreative Impulse und laden dich ein, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von Reneo mitzuwirken.

data.title: Senior Manager New Business &  Strategic Growth (w/m/x)
data.description:
Warum gibt es diese Stelle?

PIABO wächst dann nachhaltig, wenn wir zur richtigen Zeit mit den richtigen Menschen im Gespräch sind. Dafür reicht es nicht, auf Pitch-Anfragen zu warten. 
Wir wollen relevante Märkte früh verstehen, Beziehungen langfristig aufbauen und aus guten Kontakten passende Mandate entwickeln.
Was wir dafür brauchen: eine Person, die New Business als strategisches Handwerk versteht. Die den Markt liest, Chancen einordnet und verbindlich nachfasst. Und die mit Entscheider:innen aus Technologie, Venture Capital, Innovation und Unternehmenskommunikation auf Augenhöhe spricht.


Was du bei uns tust und wie

Das liegt in deiner Verantwortung:

  • Pipeline und Markt: Du baust eine belastbare New-Business-Pipeline auf, identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen und erkennst früh, wann sich durch Finanzierungsrunden, neue Führungsrollen, Markteintritte oder andere Veränderungen eine Chance für PIABO öffnet.
  • Kontakte und Beziehungen: Du entwickelst passende Gesprächsanlässe, baust Beziehungen zu potenziellen Kund:innen, Investor:innen, Partner:innen und Multiplikator:innen auf und vertrittst PIABO in relevanten Netzwerken und auf Events.
  • Qualifizierung: Du prüfst Chancen früh und sorgfältig. Budget, Timing, Umfang, Entscheidungsprozess, kulturelle Passung und strategisches Potenzial sind geklärt, bevor wir größere Ressourcen einsetzen.
  • Pitch-Prozesse: Du steuerst Pitches gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Beratungsteams. Du sorgst dafür, dass Briefing, Team, Rollen, Zeitplan, Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung stimmen.
  • Wachstumssystem: Du verbindest New Business mit PR, Thought Leadership, Events, LinkedIn, Partnerschaften und öffentlichen Ausschreibungen.
  • Struktur und Auswertung: Du entwickelst CRM, Target Lists und Follow-ups weiter und wertest aus, welche Kontakte, Leads und Pitches zu passenden Mandaten führen.

Hier bekommst du gezieltes Onboarding von uns:
  • PIABO, unsere Leistungen und unser Markt: Du lernst unsere Beratungsteams, Kund:innen, Branchen und Wachstumsfelder im Detail kennen.
  • AI und Weiterentwicklung: Du nimmst an unserem AI Bootcamp teil und entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich über die PIABO Academies weiter.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast relevante Erfahrung in New Business, Business Development, Growth, B2B-Sales und -Vertrieb, Client Development oder Beratung. Du kennst das Agenturgeschäft, eine Kommunikationsberatung, Strategieberatung, Kreativagentur, Tech-Agentur oder ein vergleichbares B2B-Umfeld. Du weißt, wie Agenturen wachsen und wie man Chancen bewertet, bevor sie Zeit und Ressourcen binden.
  • Du kannst mit CEOs, CMOs, Founder Teams und Investor:innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen, Timing und Relevanz, schreibst klar und fasst verbindlich nach. Akquise gibt dir Energie, ohne dass du platt vertrieblich auftrittst.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und konsequent. CRM, Target Lists, Kontaktpunkte, Follow-ups und klare Routinen sind für dich die Grundlage guter Arbeit. Pitches, RFIs, RFPs, Chemistry Meetings, Engagement Workshops und öffentliche Ausschreibungen kennst du aus der Praxis.


What’s in it for you?

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Die Chance, ein New-Business-System aufzubauen, das zur nächsten Wachstumsphase von PIABO passt.
  • Eine Rolle mit Sichtbarkeit in relevanten Märkten, Netzwerken und Technologie-Ökosystemen.
  • AI Upskilling als Standard: AI Bootcamp, Tools Stack und der Freiraum, deinen Arbeitsbereich mit AI wirklich besser zu machen.
  • Apple Ausstattung, Urban Sports Club, Jobrad und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Und ein paar gute Gründe mehr, die erzählen wir dir gern persönlich.

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday

data.title: Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own:

  • The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
  • The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
  • The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
  • Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
  • Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend


What You’ll Achieve

  • Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it
  • Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on. Surface dependencies early, clear blockers, and make the trade-off calls with Product and the founders.
  • We expect engineering to care about business and product and we expect you to be an example here
  • Set the architecture so it holds as data volume, customer count and the team grow.
  • Run incidents properly: fast response, honest postmortems, fixes that stop the same thing happening again
  • Keep enough processes to be reliable and no more. A 11-person team should not feel like a 100-person one
  • Work closely with Product, Data Science, our energy market experts and other disciplines, so we build against the real physical and regulatory constraints


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams before in a product company, including senior engineers or squad leads
  • You have done it in a lean team, hands-on, without a layer of managers to delegate to. Some excellent large-company leaders struggle here. There is no layer to hide behind
  • You have personally owned delivery predictability and reliability for a production system real customers depend on, and you can tell us what it looked like before and after
  • Strong technical judgment in at least two of: cloud and distributed backend / multi-tenant SaaS; high-volume or time-series data pipelines; IoT, device integration and real-time telemetry; ML or optimization in production. Deep enough to earn engineers' trust, make architecture calls and set the technical direction yourself
  • You have run hiring and performance for real: you have grown people, and you have also managed people out when that was the right call
  • You treat incident management, security and compliance as yours to own, not to delegate
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a strong plus — most of our customers are German Mittelstand
Nice to have
  • Energy, industrial, SaaS or a physical-world domain.
  • Having been the most senior technical person somewhere before (CTO, VP Engineering, or the person everyone asked).
Not required
  • Being the strongest coder on the team. You do need to read the code, make architecture calls, and occasionally build something.
  • A “Head of” title already. We look at what you have done, not what it was called.


What You Get

  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday

data.title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
data.description:
Role

Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt.

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab.


Your tasks

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen.

  • Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen.

  • Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor.

  • Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin.

  • Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst.

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.


Why us?

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

  • Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit.

  • Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

  • Team: Ein junges, motiviertes und wirklich gutes Team in Prenzlauer Berg. Teamevents, Ausflüge sowie Bier und Wein im Kühlschrank gehören dazu.

  • Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie ein Urban Sports Club Abo.

data.title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
Your mission

Do you want to do more than just write security concepts - and put your decisions into practice directly? Do you see cloud security not as a compliance checklist, but as the combination of threat modeling, Infrastructure as Code, and genuine hands-on engineering? Then we are looking for you to join our CISO team as a Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d) in a hybrid working model in Munich, Berlin or Halle (Saale).
You will join a three-person team where responsibility is genuinely shared: no ticket queues and no “that’s not my area.” We plan together, cover for one another, and usually implement and operate the security controls we design ourselves. This means you will see the impact of your work immediately - not at some point in the distant future.
Your Responsibilities

  • Security Architecture & Cloud Guardrails: You will take technical ownership of the security architecture and controls across our Azure environment - from Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel to Log Analytics. You will build and maintain the corresponding guardrails directly in Terraform.
  • Detection Engineering: You will develop and continuously improve our detections in close collaboration with our Security Analyst, who is responsible for day-to-day SIEM monitoring and triage. You will work as a well-coordinated team rather than in separate silos.
  • Vulnerability Management: You will further develop our vulnerability management and monitoring across a hybrid environment. This includes our growing cloud landscape as well as the existing on-premises stack for as long as the migration is ongoing.
  • Security Beyond the Cloud: You will contribute your expertise beyond cloud security, including identity, endpoint security, application security, incident response, and AI. Using your security engineering skills, you will, for example, develop tooling for AI-assisted penetration testing within our team and translate it into practical, scalable processes.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: You will use tools such as Claude Code to build and maintain internal security tools and automations. At the same time, you will help us identify AI-specific risks early—from the secure use of AI coding assistants to prompt injection.


Your skillset

  • Azure Security & Certifications: You have at least five years of experience in security engineering and several years of hands-on experience implementing Azure security. You hold an AZ-500 certification or have equivalent practical expertise. SC-100, CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certifications are a plus.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: You can confidently read, write, and further develop security-related Terraform code. Experience with Python, Django, PowerShell, or AI-assisted development is a plus.
  • Identity & Detection: You have practical experience with Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM, as well as solid knowledge of network security, SIEM, and detection engineering.
  • Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management: Ideally, you have experience with traditional or AI-assisted penetration testing and with tools such as Tenable or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Hands-On Mindset: You do not just design security controls -you implement and operate them in practice. When you identify a problem, you do not wait for a ticket; you take ownership and develop a solution.

Du verantwortest ein strategisch relevantes Vertriebsgebiet, baust Beziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträger:innen weiter aus und steigerst die kommerzielle Performance durch strategische Beratung und eine konsequente Betreuung deiner Accounts.

Sales Growth

Account Management

  • Betreuung und strategische Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios bedeutender Apotheken und Kliniken.

  • Aufbau langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern und Entscheidungsträger:innen.

Markt- & Geschäftsanalyse

  • Kontinuierliche Beobachtung von Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Marktentwicklungen.

  • Weitergabe relevanter Marktkenntnisse und Kundenfeedbacks an das Sales Leadership Team zur Weiterentwicklung der kommerziellen Strategie.

  • Sorgfältige Pflege des CRM-Systems sowie zuverlässiges Reporting relevanter KPIs.

Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus Inside Sales, Customer Service, Logistics und Compliance.

  • Partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Medical- und Marketing-Teams bei Informations-, Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen.

  • Teilnahme an relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen sowie professionelle Repräsentation von Montu.

Außendienst

  • Durchführung gezielter persönlicher Kundenbesuche mit Fokus auf qualitativ hochwertige und wirkungsorientierte Termine anstelle einer reinen Maximierung der Besuchsanzahl.

Was bringst du mit?

  • Berufserfahrung im Bereich Sales, Key Account Management oder Business Development.

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, in der Pharmaindustrie, Medizintechnik oder einer anderen regulierten Branche ist von Vorteil.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.

  • Fähigkeit, medizinische und therapeutische Informationen zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln.

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Erfahrung im Management einer vielfältigen Sales-Pipeline.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Gültiger Führerschein.

Warum Montu?

  • Gestalte mit uns durch innovative Telemedizinlösungen die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung in Deutschland.

  • Werde Teil eines internationalen Teams mit einer kollaborativen und flexiblen Arbeitskultur.

  • Arbeite in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen, in dem deine Arbeit direkten und sichtbaren Einfluss hat.

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens einem Tag pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro.

Bei Montu sind wir davon überzeugt, dass der Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung einfach, schnell und auf den Menschen ausgerichtet sein sollte – nicht auf Systeme. Deshalb gestalten wir die Patient Journey neu: mit einer nahtlosen, digital ausgerichteten Erfahrung, die medizinische Versorgung leichter zugänglich macht.
Unsere innovative Telemedizinplattform, unsere internationale Präsenz und unser umfassendes Portfolio an cannabisbasierten Arzneimitteln unterstützen Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheker:innen dabei, traditionelle Barrieren zu überwinden und Menschen zu befähigen, ihre Gesundheit selbstbestimmt in die Hand zu nehmen.

data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Role

As an Analyst in our Education division, you will join an international team of data professionals and become a key contributor to the analytical backbone of our education projects.

You will manage ranking projects alongside the data team, develop new rankings and data products, and identify, collect, and analyze the education data that powers our work. As part of an interdisciplinary project team, you will help measure education impact across multiple sectors — directly supporting Statista's mission to make education quality transparent on a global scale.

 

Your Tasks

  • Work on multi-faceted collaborative projects with international clients and media partners with a focus on the education sector (universities, colleges, EdTech etc.)

  • Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s education rankings and data products, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability

  • Support in managing ranking projects, ensuring data quality and transparent outcomes. Gradually take on project responsibility and increasingly engage in direct customer contact.

  • Conduct research and analysis of primary and secondary data of education institutions in various countries

  • Planning, implementation, and analysis of international surveys in the education sector

  • Efficient and structured presentation of results in Excel and PowerPoint

  • Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven education products and improvement of existing workflows

Your Profile

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Economics, Social Science, or related field preferred; Bachelor's with significant relevant experience considered

  • 1-2 years of experience in data analysis and/or project management, ideally in an education focused research area (e.g. institutional research, strategic planning, education research etc.) or a related research field

  • Initial experience in supporting data-driven insight projects

  • Basic understanding of current education trends and policy landscapes

  • Very good analytical / quantitative skills, a high degree of initiative and a high-quality standard

  • Good understanding of Microsoft 365 (esp. advanced Excel)

  • Experience in programming languages is an advantage (e.g., Python)

  • Fluent in English, German or other languages a plus

  • Highly structured, curious, and motivated to work in an international and cross-functional environment

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

data.title: Internship - Workplace and People Operations
data.description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission

As the Workplace Operations Intern at telli, you help create the environment our team does its best work in. You support everything around our Berlin office, team events, and workplace experience - and get a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates day to day. Perfect if you want to learn how a fast-moving startup works from the inside.

what you’ll do:

  • keep our Berlin office running smoothly - supplies, equipment, and making the space a place people want to be

  • support planning and running team events: offsites, onsite interviews, team dinners, and community events

  • help new joiners have a great first day - desk setup, hardware, and access

  • coordinate with vendors and service providers for everything office-related

  • learn to build small automations around workplace ops (ordering, inventory, requests) with AI and no-code tools

  • jump in on ad-hoc tasks and support the team wherever help is needed

what makes you a great fit:

  • you are hands-on and not afraid of doing unglamorous work

  • you're organized, reliable, and notice details others miss

  • you're curious about tools and automation and pick up new things fast

  • you take initiative and don't wait for detailed instructions

  • you're a strong communicator in both English and German

  • you're a host at heart - you enjoy creating great experiences for others

you may not make a good fit if:

  • you only want to do high-level "strategic" work

  • you aren't comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

  • you prefer working fully remote - this role lives in the office

  • you'd rather observe than roll up your sleeves

data.title: Account Executive (all genders)
data.description:
Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter.

Als Account Executive (all genders) bist du ein zentraler Treiber unseres Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen.

What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen.

  • Negotiate & close: Du führst Verhandlungen auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen, gehst souverän mit Einwänden um und bringst Deals erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

  • Grow your accounts: Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und identifizierst weiteres Potenzial in bestehenden Accounts. Dein Ziel sind nicht nur gewonnene Deals, sondern nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

  • Own your performance: Du kennst deine Pipeline und KPIs, analysierst deine Ergebnisse und entwickelst deinen Sales Approach kontinuierlich weiter.

Inspire us by

  • Sales Experience: Du bringst mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales mit und hast bereits eigenständig Kunden gewonnen und Deals abgeschlossen. Erfahrung mit Small und Medium Accounts ist ein Plus.

  • Ambition & Drive: Du setzt dir hohe Ziele, willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen und bleibst auch dann dran, wenn es herausfordernd wird.

  • Communication: Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und kommunizierst souverän mit Entscheidern auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen.

  • Commercial Mindset: Du verstehst Geschäftsmodelle und Kundenbedürfnisse und kannst daraus relevante Sales Opportunities entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datenbasiert.

  • Growth Mindset: Du willst kontinuierlich besser werden, suchst aktiv Feedback und setzt Learnings direkt in bessere Ergebnisse um.

  • Languages: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sprichst fließend Englisch.

  • Mobility: Du hast einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen (ca. 10–20 %).

What we offer

  • Earn & grow: Attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und ungedeckeltem Bonus – starke Performance soll sich für dich lohnen.

  • Learn fast: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Own your numbers: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und KPIs und hast gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deinen eigenen Sales Style zu entwickeln.

  • Work smarter with AI: KI ist Teil deines täglichen Workflows – für effizienteren Research, bessere Insights und schnellere Vorbereitung.

  • Flexibility & Mobility: Drei feste Office-Tage in München-Thalkirchen, flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie Bike-Leasing oder Fahrtkostenzuschuss.

  • Team & Culture: Eine ambitionierte Teamkultur, kurze Wege und gemeinsame Erfolge bei Teamevents und OKR-Partys.

  • Health & Balance: EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen.

  • Best-in-class setup: Mac oder Windows, ergonomisches Equipment und alles, was du für effizientes Arbeiten im Office und Homeoffice brauchst.

  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – uns interessiert, was du bewegst, nicht was du trägst.

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

Still here?
Dann könnten wir ein perfektes Match sein!

Bewirb dich am besten über unser Bewerbungsportal - so landet deine Bewerbung direkt bei uns im Team und wir können sie schnell und unkompliziert prüfen.

data.description:
About Apheris

At Apheris, we are building the future of how AI is applied in pharmaceutical R&D. We enable leading pharmaceutical teams to discover and develop drugs faster. We host the industry’s largest federated data networks for drug discovery AI, spanning co-folding, ADMET, and antibody developability. 

Across these networks, models are trained on proprietary industry datasets to achieve higher performance and broader applicability while keeping data control and IP protected. We deliver these superior models through drug discovery applications that enable teams to run them at scale, further customize them, and integrate them into existing R&D workflows. 

  • AI Structural Biology (AISB) Network: Pharmaceutical companies collaborate in the field of co-folding, structure-based binding affinity predictions and antibody design.
  • ADMET Network: Pharmaceutical and biotech companies collaborate to improve small-molecule property prediction and expand into further drug modalities.
  • Antibody Developability Network: Pharma partners collaborate to federate historical and purpose-built antibody developability data sets for secure ML training, without data leaving each partner’s environment.


About the role

As a Working Student in Finance, you’ll be an integral part of our Finance team, supporting core processes that keep our business running smoothly. You’ll gain hands-on experience in Accounts Payable and Receivable, Expense Management, and Financial Reporting while working closely with cross-functional teams in an international environment.


What you will do

Accounts Payable

Expense Reporting

Payroll
  • Support the monthly payroll cycle across our entities and EOR countries, working closely with our Finance Manager who owns the process end to end
  • Check trial payslips against our records and flag discrepancies
  • Help keep payroll documentation and personnel files audit-ready and in line with data protection requirements
Yearly Closing & Audit
  • Assist in audit preparation by compiling documentation necessary for answering auditor inquiries

Operations
  • Monitor the shared finance inbox and route incoming requests and invoices to the right place
  • Assist with day-to-day finance operations or ad hoc requests
  • Support the documentation of finance processes in our internal wiki as we build out investor-ready controls

What we expect from you

  • Solid skills in Microsoft Office, especially Excel
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for working with AI tools. Prior experience is a plus, but a willingness to experiment matters more

What we offer you

  • A dynamic role with steep learning opportunities and real impact
  • Remote-first working - work where you work best, whether from home or a co-working space near you 
  • Flexible working hours tailored to your study schedule
  • Monthly wellbeing budget

Logistics

The interviewer will be interested in your relevant experiences and skills, as well as answer any question on the company and the role itself that you may have.

Job description

Who we are 
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

The Role
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

We are hiring a Logistics Manager to help scale Yepoda's global inbound logistics operations across air and ocean freight. In this hands-on role, you will own end-to-end shipment flow from manufacturing sites to warehouses, and balance strategic freight forwarder management with day-to-day operational execution.


Your Tasks

  • Manage end-to-end inbound logistics from manufacturing sites to warehouses, covering international air and ocean freight.

  • Lead freight forwarder management, including rate negotiations, provider nominations, shipment bookings, service performance, and issue resolution.

  • Ensure proactive shipment tracking and exception management, addressing delays, capacity constraints, documentation issues, and other logistics disruptions.

  • Provide customs brokers with accurate and timely shipment, product, and commercial data required for customs clearance, and support resolution of clearance-related queries.

  • Maintain accurate shipment, transport, and inventory movement data in the ERP system.

  • Coordinate inter-warehouse transfers based on transfer requirements defined by Procurement, including transport arrangements, system transactions, and follow-up through to completion.

  • Monitor and report key logistics KPIs, including freight cost, transit time, on-time delivery, and service-provider performance.

  • Drive logistics optimization and operational excellence through strategic, data-driven decision-making and continuous process improvement.

  • Act as the main point of contact for logistics topics, coordinating with manufacturing sites, warehouses, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Mentor and develop a junior colleague, fostering knowledge sharing, capability building, and continuous growth within the team.

data.title: Microwave Design Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

  • Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

  • Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

  • Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

  • Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

  • Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

  • Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

  • Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)
