data.title: Executive Audience Manager
data.description:
About The Alliance

When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.


The Role

Our executive programmes only work if the right people are in the room. As Executive Audience Manager, you own the audience for our invitation-only events. You identify the senior leaders who belong at each table, you earn their attention, and you convert that attention into confirmed, qualified, high-value attendance. Our Content and Events teams build the experience. You build the room.

You'll work closely with Commercial, Partnerships and Marketing, and you'll own the executive relationship end to end: from first touch and qualification, through confirmation and show-up, to the follow-up that turns a one-time attendee into a long-term member of the community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the target audience: Work with Commercial and Marketing to translate each event's brief into a clear, named list of the executives who should be there, and the seniority and profile criteria that qualify them.

  • Build and run executive outreach. Own multi-channel campaigns across personalised email, LinkedIn, phone, referrals and warm introductions. Own the volume, own the follow-up, own the pipeline.

  • Qualify rigorously. Confirm seniority, decision-making authority, budget relevance and peer fit before an invitation is issued. Protect the quality of the room, including when that means saying no.

  • Convert and hold attendance. Manage invitations, confirmations, pre-event communications and reconfirmation with a white-glove touch. Minimise drop-out and keep every confirmed guest engaged right up to the day.

  • Hand over cleanly. Give the Events and Content teams a fully briefed, confirmed audience ahead of every event, with the profile detail they need to run the room well.

  • Retain and grow. Maintain relationships after the event, drive repeat attendance, and grow our executive communities through referrals and exclusive engagement opportunities.

  • Share what you learn. Capture commercial and market insight from your conversations, keep the CRM clean and current, and give internal teams warm, well-briefed handovers.

What Success Looks Like: You are measured on the quality and reliability of the audience you deliver.

Success means every event opens with a full room of genuinely senior, genuinely relevant executives who wanted to be there. It means low drop-out, high repeat attendance and a growing pool of executive relationships that belong to The Alliance rather than to any single campaign. It means Commercial and Event teams who trust that when you say the audience is secured, it is secured. And it means attendees who accept the next invitation because the last one was worth their evening.

What We're Looking For

  • Relevant experience could be in executive audience acquisition, B2B events, executive networking, partnerships, business development, or community building.

  • Comfortable approaching, engaging and holding the attention of C-suite and senior decision-makers, mostly by email, LinkedIn and phone.

  • A closer's instinct for follow-up. You are persistent without being a nuisance, and you don't lose people in the gap between interest and confirmation.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Your outreach reads like a person, not a template

  • Highly organised with the attention to detail that white-glove executive handling demands.

  • Comfortable owning a target and working to a deadline that does not move, because the event date does not move.

  • Experience using CRM platforms, LinkedIn, and outreach tools is an advantage.

What This Role Is Not

To help you self-select: this is not an event production, logistics or on-site hosting role. You will not be sourcing venues, running the operational build or working the room on the night. Our Events team owns all of that. This is an acquisition and relationship role, and your week is spent in outreach and conversation with senior executives.

Benefits: We believe exceptional people deserve exceptional support.

Time Off:

  • 34 days' annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays.

  • Your birthday is off every year.

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Enhanced family policies.

  • Private Medical Insurance.

  • Life Insurance (4x salary).

  • On-demand therapy, coaching, and mental fitness support through Oliva.

  • Heavily subsidised gym membership via Wellness Hub.

  • Cycle to Work and Workplace Nursery schemes.

Flexibility:

  • Flexible working hours, allowing you to work when you are most productive.

  • Monthly allowance via ThanksBen (£600 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

Learning & Development:

  • Personal L&D budget (£500 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

  • Four paid Learning & Development or Volunteer Days each year.

  • Team training and development opportunities.

Equipment & Culture

  • New tech setup including laptop, screen, mouse, and keyboard.

  • Company social events.

  • A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive working environment.

Community & Inclusion

At The Alliance, we're committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

We know our work here is never done, and we continue to strive for a more inclusive environment every day.

If you're worried you don't meet every requirement listed, don't let that stop you from applying. Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential to our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you'd be a great fit, we'd love to hear from you.

We are The Alliance—in more ways than one.

Compensation: £33.5K – £35K • £5K – £15K Commission

What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. The opportunity.

Want to transform customer engagement and growth at some of the world's largest institutions? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our Customer Intelligence solution. You'll own the solution across banking, insurance and the public sector, set the direction for the whole region, and take it to market – with real autonomy over how. You'll be the name the market knows on this subject, and the person Quantexa turns to for it.

Every large organisation is investing in data, analytics and AI to serve customers better. Most hit the same wall. The same person appears multiple times across systems that don't talk to each other. Relationships stay hidden – from families and social groups to corporate hierarchies and supply chains. The data is there, but it's fragmented, inconsistent and stripped of context, so nobody quite trusts what it says. The cost shows up everywhere: disjointed customer experiences, frustrated customer-facing teams, wasted marketing spend, and revenue left on the table.

That's the problem we solve, at scale. We connect data to build a real-world view of people, businesses, places and events, and the relationships between them – unlocking insight that accelerates revenue growth and makes customer experience genuinely better.   • Judgement, and generosity with it. There’ll always be more opportunity than time, so you’ll choose well and bring colleagues, partners and clients with you. Experience across several EMEA markets, or extra languages, is welcome rather than required.

Our perks and quirks.

data.title: Head of Social
data.description:
About the Role:

Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, the Head of Social will be responsible for defining and driving TALA’s organic social strategy and growth agenda across our key social channels.

You will lead our social team, setting the strategic direction, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring our social channels build brand awareness, cultural relevance, community and channel growth. You will balance creativity with data and commercial thinking, ensuring we are not just creating content, but building a social presence that drives the business forward.

You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, Influencer, PR, Product and Ecommerce teams, ensuring social is connected to the wider marketing strategy and that TALA continues to be ahead of the conversation.

We’re looking for a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable setting the direction, managing a team and getting into the details when needed.

Tasks

Day to day this looks like:

  • Social Strategy: Own and evolve TALA’s organic social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, with oversight of Pinterest and LinkedIn, setting clear objectives, channel roles, audiences, content pillars and KPIs.
  • Growth Strategy: Identify opportunities to grow TALA’s social audience, reach and relevance, developing strategies to increase awareness, engagement and community.
  • Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment.
  • Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Provide clear strategic direction and briefs to the content creators within the team, ensuring content is distinctive, relevant, engaging and effective against our KPIs.
  • Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel.
  • Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth.
  • Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches.
  • Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy.
  • Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy.
  • Channel Health: Oversee the overall health and performance of TALA’s social channels, ensuring content is consistent, on-brand and delivering against agreed objectives. You will provide strategic direction while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution.
  • Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business.
  • Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy
  • Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience.
  • Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets.

Requirements

You should:

  • Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
  • Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team.
  • Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce.
  • Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach.
  • Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth.
  • Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn.
  • Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel.
  • Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts.
  • Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture.
  • Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams.
  • Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment.
  • Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources.
  • Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required.
  • Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth.
  • Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth.

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.

About the Role:

Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, we’re looking for a Head of VIP, Influencers & PR to build TALA’s profile, cultural relevance and desirability through the people, partnerships, moments and conversations that matter.

You’ll lead the strategy across VIP partnerships, Influencers, Ambassadors, Pro, PR, gifting and events, turning TALA into a brand that people see, talk about and want to be part of.

You’ll know and understand that the fastest way to build awareness is to put TALA in the right hands, in the right places, with the right people.

The successful candidate will bring a serious black book of relevant VIPs from celebrities and musicians to stylists, athletes, creators and cultural tastemakers and know how to build genuine relationships with them.

You’ll be responsible for creating the moments that make TALA feel bigger, more culturally relevant and impossible to ignore.

Tasks

What You’ll Own

VIP & Cultural Partnerships

  • Build and own TALA’s VIP strategy, identifying the people who can meaningfully increase awareness, desirability and cultural relevance.
  • Develop relationships with celebrities, musicians, stylists, athletes, tastemakers and influential cultural figures.
  • Bring a strong existing network and continually build TALA’s VIP black book.
  • Create strategic partnerships that go beyond gifting from organic product placement to collaborations, appearances and brand moments.
  • Ensure TALA is consistently seen on the right people, in the right places and at the right cultural moments.

Ambassador & Pro Programmes

  • Own the strategy, vision and evolution of TALA’s Ambassador and Pro programmes.
  • Define the role these programmes play within TALA’s broader brand and awareness strategy, including who we want to attract, why they matter and what we want them to deliver.
  • Establish the programme proposition, structure, tiers, criteria and long-term growth strategy.
  • Together with the team, build a best-in-class network of ambassadors and professional athletes who genuinely align with TALA and can become powerful advocates for the brand.
  • Set the strategic direction for recruitment, relationship development, activation and retention, with the team responsible for day-to-day programme management and execution.
  • Continuously assess and evolve the programmes based on KPIs including brand impact, reach, engagement and commercial contribution.

Influencer

  • Own the overall influencer strategy, defining how influencer partnerships drive awareness, cultural relevance, desirability and growth.
  • Set the direction for the talent TALA works with, from high-profile creators and cultural tastemakers to emerging talent and community voices.
  • Identify opportunities to move beyond traditional influencer activity into cultural partnerships, organic product placement and high-impact moments.
  • Ensure influencer strategy is integrated with VIP, Ambassador, Pro, PR, gifting, social and campaign activity.
  • Set clear KPIs and continuously evolve the strategy based on performance and cultural opportunity.

Gifting

  • Own the strategic direction for TALA gifting, transforming it from a reactive PR function into a significant awareness and brand-building engine.
  • Together with the team, define who TALA should be gifting, when, why and what we want gifting to achieve.
  • Oversee the strategy for key product launches, cultural moments, VIP gifting, stylist seeding and wider brand moments.
  • Lead the team in developing, signing off and executing gifting programmes, ensuring activity ladders back to wider brand and campaign priorities.

PR

  • Together with the Brand Marketing Director own the overall PR strategy and communications agenda for TALA.
  • Define the role of PR within the wider brand strategy and how it will contribute to building fame, credibility and awareness.
  • Set the annual PR strategy, priorities, narratives and key cultural moments, working closely with Brand Marketing, Social, Influencer and Product.

Events & Experiences

  • TALA is increasingly seen on the right people.

  • TALA earns more high-quality PR and cultural coverage.

About the Role

Ramp partners with football clubs to introduce relevant businesses to Ramp and create measurable commercial value for both organisations.

As the UK Football Channel Partner Manager, you will nurture and grow Ramp’s existing UK football-club partnerships. You will work with each club to activate the partnership assets we have agreed—including business-community activations, hospitality, warm introductions, campaigns, and follow-up—and ensure each partnership generates qualified sales opportunities for Ramp.

You will work closely with club commercial and partnership teams, alongside Ramp’s Sales, Marketing, Events, Product, and Engineering teams. Championship partnerships will focus on building repeatable, club-sourced pipeline from UK small and medium-sized businesses. Premier League partnerships will focus on senior executive relationships, curated hospitality, strategic introductions, and enterprise pipeline influence.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role for someone who combines strong partner management with excellent commercial judgement and execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the activation and commercial performance of Ramp’s current UK football-club partnerships.

  • Build intentional, club-specific commercial plans using agreed partnership assets. Plans may include target-account lists, events, campaigns, warm-introduction routes, and clear success measures.

  • Partner with club commercial teams to identify and engage relevant local businesses, corporate partners, suppliers, business-club members, owners, and finance leaders.

  • Plan and deliver matchday hospitality, executive dinners, business-networking events, and other activations that create high-quality meetings and introductions for Ramp.

  • Lead club-led outreach and campaigns, ensuring audiences are relevant, appropriately permissioned, and measurable.

  • Coordinate introductions and follow-up with Ramp’s Sales team so club activity becomes meaningful sales opportunities.

  • Track performance from club activity through qualified lead, accepted meeting, application, and activated customer.

  • Run regular partner operating reviews and quarterly business reviews; use results to improve activation plans and hold teams accountable to agreed commitments.

  • Coordinate internal teams across Marketing, Growth, Sales, Events, Product, and Engineering to support club activations and customer onboarding.

  • Build a deep understanding of Ramp’s products, customer value, and workflows so you can represent Ramp credibly with club partners and prospects.

What You Need

  • 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in partnerships, business development, partner sales, account management, or commercial strategy.

  • A track record of building trusted senior relationships and delivering measurable commercial results through partners.

  • Strong event, hospitality, campaign, and go-to-market execution skills.

  • Excellent judgement when identifying high-quality prospects, shaping warm introductions, and coordinating multiple stakeholders.

  • Comfort using performance data to improve plans, report results, and manage to goals.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills.

  • A highly collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively across teams.

  • The ability to manage stakeholders across different functions and keep complex activity moving.

  • UK-based, with flexibility to travel more than 60% of the time and to support evening and weekend matchday and event commitments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with UK football clubs, sports properties, business communities, sponsorships, or commercial partnerships.

  • Experience creating B2B pipeline through events, hospitality, account-based campaigns, or partner networks.

  • Familiarity with the UK small and medium-sized business market and finance-leader audience.

  • Understanding of sports business, media, branding, or investing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every football-club partnership has a clear commercial plan covering agreed activity, target audiences, goals, and measures of success.

  • Each activation has a named owner at Ramp and at the club who is accountable for delivery.

  • Club activity consistently creates qualified leads and sales opportunities for Ramp.

  • Ramp and club teams work seamlessly to deliver events, campaigns, introductions, and follow-up.

data.title: Deployment Strategist
data.description:
Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that.

We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises.

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment.

You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale.

What You’ll Do

You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests.

  • Own deployments end-to-end—design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing.

  • Hold the senior relationships—be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations.

  • Find the value nobody has scoped—go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next.

  • Define best practice for AI deployment—set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale.

  • Shape our roadmap—bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build.

You Might Be a Great Fit if You

  • Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role

  • Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted

  • Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue

  • Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague

Bonus Points

  • Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations

  • Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings

Compensation and Benefits

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside

  • A salary of £100-110k

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown

  • In-office lunches provided

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Hybrid London HQ (WFH Thurs and every other Tues, with flex if you have appointments etc)

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build

Our Interview Process

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  2. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.

  3. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.

Responsible AI Statement

At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

Magentic is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, or any other basis as protected by the Equality Act 2010.

We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and cultures and believe a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver innovative solutions. We also ensure that our employment decisions are based solely on individual qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Magentic is dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application or contact us directly.

data.description:
Le contexte :

Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

 

Le rôle :

Le FDE est un vecteur de transformation permanent. Son quotidien : aller chercher les problèmes là où ils se trouvent, construire les solutions au plus près des utilisateurs, et s’assurer qu’elles tiennent dans la durée.

Identifier les opportunités de transformation :

·       Configurer, tester et mettre en production les solutions, en assurant leur fiabilité

Accompagner l’adoption et décentraliser les capacités

·       Former les consultants à l’utilisation des outils et, surtout, à la construction de leurs propres solutions

·       Créer la documentation, les guides et les bonnes pratiques pour rendre l’autonomie possible

·       Identifier et accompagner les « champions IA » dans chaque équipe pour relayer la transformation

Contribuer à la feuille de route IA du cabinet :

·       Remonter les retours terrain à l’équipe centrale pour alimenter la roadmap produit

·       Suivre les évolutions de l’écosystème IA/LLM (nouveaux modèles, frameworks, outils)

Ce que nous offrons :

·       L’accès direct à Dust, aux API des principaux LLM du marché, et à une plateforme de création d’applications

·       Une exposition unique aux métiers du conseil financier et opérationnel (transactions, restructurations, transformations)

Ce poste est fait pour quelqu’un qui vit l’IA au quotidien. Pas comme un sujet académique, mais comme un outil qu’il utilise, teste, détourne et pousse dans ses retranchements. La curiosité et l’enthousiasme pour l’IA sont absolument indispensables.

Compétences techniques :

Qualités personnelles :

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
Nous souhaitons rendre le droit plus accessible et compréhensible.
Pour ce faire nous construisons des produits à destination des professionnels du droit (avocats et juristes) afin de leur permettre d'accéder à toutes les informations juridiques dont ils ont besoin pour conseiller au mieux les justiciables.
 
Doctrine offre à ses abonnés la possibilité de demander des décisions de justice qu'ils n'ont pas trouvées sur le moteur de recherche.
Notre stagiaire a pour principale mission d’assurer, en autonomie, le traitement de ces demandes grâce à son expertise juridique.
 
En plus de cette fonction première, tu interagiras avec les équipes en charge de la relation client dans le cadre du traitement des demandes des abonnés, tu seras sollicité·e sur des sujets quotidiens et de pointe (gestion du pré-contentieux et de la conformité, mais aussi recherches sur le droit de l’IA ou des données personnelles) et amené à conseiller les équipes produit sur les évolutions de Doctrine ou ses futures fonctionnalités.
 
Ton profil : Tu es à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois. Tu as une expérience de la recherche d'informations juridiques, une connaissance de la procédure et des institutions judiciaires françaises, et sais faire preuve de créativité face à une situation nouvelle. Idéalement, tu as une expertise en droit du numérique.

Les missions :

L'équipe ILF Solar Photovoltaic & Hybrid Systems intervient sur une large gamme de projets et programmes d'énergies renouvelables et de stockage d´énergie de grande envergure, raccordés au réseau ou hors réseau, pour des clients publics et privés dans le monde entier. Nous vous offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et de contribuer à des projets uniques et innovants (PV flottant, systèmes hybrides complexes, intégration de l'hydrogène, électrification rurale, etc.).

Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Chef de Projet Senior Photovoltaïque & stockage (BESS) (H/F) et contribuez à la transition vers un avenir énergétique durable et décarboné !

Principales responsabilités

  • Assurer la gestion de projets stratégiques internationaux dans les domaines du photovoltaïque et des systèmes de stockage d'énergie par batteries (BESS). Les clients comprennent notamment des institutions financières internationales (AFD, KfW, Banque mondiale, BERD, BEI, etc.), des compagnies nationales d'électricité ainsi que d'importants clients privés (industriels, développeurs de projets, etc.).

  • Diriger les études de faisabilité de systèmes complexes de production d'énergie : dimensionnement et optimisation des systèmes, estimation des CAPEX et OPEX, conception préliminaire et détaillée, études de raccordement réseau MT/HT, études de stabilité (PSS®E, PowerFactory), schémas directeurs énergétiques (PLEXOS, PyPSA), etc. Prendre également la responsabilité de missions de Due Diligence Technique (TDD), de Conseil technique des bailleurs de fonds (LTA), de Conseil technique en transactions.

  • Piloter les phases d'exécution des projets : préparation des dossiers d'appel d'offres, évaluation des offres EPC/IPP, validation des études d'exécution avant construction et supervision des phases de construction, mise en service et exploitation-maintenance.

  • Assurer l'interface avec les fournisseurs, les contractants EPC/IPP et les clients, tout en suivant les évolutions technologiques, les tendances du marché, les nouveaux produits, les normes et les modèles de simulation.

  • Contribuer à la standardisation des processus de travail afin d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et la qualité des prestations.

  • Participer au développement des activités internationales à travers la préparation d'offres techniques et commerciales et soutenir les initiatives de développement commercial.

Profil recherché

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou formation équivalente en énergie, génie électrique ou domaine similaire, avec une spécialisation en énergies renouvelables, photovoltaïque ou systèmes de stockage d'énergie (BESS).

  • Minimum 10 ans d'expérience dans les projets photovoltaïques et systèmes de stockage à grande échelle, associée à de solides compétences en gestion de projet et en ingénierie. Une expérience dans l'éolien et l'hydrogène vert constitue un atout.

  • Maîtrise des logiciels du secteur énergétique tels que PVSyst, HOMER PRO et/ou des logiciels de simulation de réseaux électriques (PowerFactory, PSS®E).

  • Bonne compréhension des aspects techniques des contrats PPA et EPC, notamment en matière de performance, de pénalités contractuelles et de risques contractuels.

  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles.

  • Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.


91 % de nos collaborateurs considèrent ILF Allemagne & France comme un « Great Place to Work ».

  • Culture d’entreprise conviviale et diversité vécue au quotidien

    De nombreux événements locaux et interrégionaux renforcent l’esprit d’équipe, et la majorité des collaborateurs se tutoient. Nous sommes particulièrement fiers de la diversité internationale de nos équipes, qui regroupent plus de 30 nationalités.

  • Environnement de travail moderne

    Sur l’ensemble de nos sites, nos collaborateurs bénéficient de postes de travail modernes et de haute qualité, équipés notamment de bureaux réglables en hauteur.

  • Développement et réseau professionnel

    Chaque collaborateur dispose d’un budget annuel de formation utilisable pour des plateformes d’apprentissage externes (comme Udemy) ainsi que pour notre ILF Academy interne. Des entretiens réguliers de développement permettent d’explorer de nouvelles responsabilités ou des évolutions de carrière. Les jeunes ingénieurs se retrouvent également régulièrement au sein du Young Engineers Club.

  • Des avantages au-delà du salaire

    Nous partageons les bénéfices de l’entreprise avec nos collaborateurs et récompensons les recommandations de candidats, les publications techniques ainsi que les interventions lors de conférences par des primes attractives. Les réalisations exceptionnelles sont mises à l’honneur grâce à nos Excellence Awards. En complément, chacun peut choisir entre une carte avantages Pluxee, une assurance santé complémentaire

  • Dimension internationale et diversité

    Au sein du Groupe ILF, encore dirigé par ses familles fondatrices et présent sur plus de 45 sites à travers le monde avec plus de 3 700 collaborateurs, nous travaillons sur des projets nationaux et internationaux dans des équipes multiculturelles représentant plus de 30 nationalités.

  • Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée

    Nous proposons des solutions flexibles adaptées aux besoins individuels, tant en matière d’horaires de travail (horaires flexibles, temps partiel) que de lieu de travail (télétravail, mobilité entre sites, missions internationales).

data.title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
data.description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou

combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers.

Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du

projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/

MISSIONS

Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes :

  1. Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de

fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes

que les modèles acquièrent.

3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet.

ACTIVITÉS :

  1. Critères de diversité dans les représentations :

• Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de

fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables.

• Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus

ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus

compacte que la seule importance individuelle.

• Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les

profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues.

2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes :

• Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des

modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement.

• Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les

mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation.

• Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en

particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

3. Production scientifique et vie du projet :

• Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales.

• Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats.


Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :

🎓 Doctorat obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d'embauche, en apprentissage automatique, informatique, traitement du signal ou mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

✔️ Solide maîtrise de l'apprentissage profond et de ses fondements mathématiques.

✔️ Pratique courante de Python et d'un cadre d'apprentissage profond, PyTorch de préférence.

✔️ Expérience de travail sur des architectures de type transformer, et capacité à instrumenter leurs représentations internes.

✔️ Autonomie dans la conduite d'expériences sur GPU, y compris sur une infrastructure de calcul partagée.

🇬🇧 Publications dans des conférences ou revues internationales du domaine, et très bon niveau d'anglais scientifique, écrit comme oral.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

✨ Connaissance de l'interprétabilité mécaniste : autoencodeurs parcimonieux, sondes linéaires, analyse de circuits.

✨ Familiarité avec les processus ponctuels déterminantaux, ou plus généralement avec les méthodes d'échantillonnage et l'algèbre linéaire aléatoire.

✨ Intérêt pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

✨ Expérience du calcul distribué multi-GPU et d'un ordonnanceur de type SLURM.

Capacités et aptitudes :

✔️ Autonomie scientifique et goût pour les questions ouvertes, le poste comportant une part exploratoire assumée.

✔️ Rigueur expérimentale et attention portée à la reproductibilité.

✔️ Goût du travail collectif : le poste est en interaction directe avec plusieurs doctorants du projet.

✔️ Qualités rédactionnelles, et capacité à présenter des résultats à un public non spécialiste.

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES

• La maîtrise du français n'est pas requise : l'anglais est la langue de travail de l'équipe dès qu'un de ses membres n'est pas francophone.

• Les publications issues du projet sont déposées

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE :

LE PLUS :

Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

C'est quoi l'équipe Produit Poker ? 

Notre mission est de concevoir et faire évoluer l'expérience poker chez Winamax. Nous définissons la roadmap produit, aussi bien pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités (Reveal, Moods, Shots, Winamax Legends...) que pour les grands projets structurants de l'application (refonte des lobbys, nouveaux parcours utilisateurs, nouvelles variantes de jeu, etc.).

A PROPOS DU POSTE

Ton grand défi sera d'imaginer une solution innovante pour améliorer l'expérience des nouveaux joueurs. Un objectif ambitieux que tu concrétiseras grâce à l'apprentissage progressif de notre métier et de nos méthodes.

 Ce que tu vas apprendre : 

L'un de nos principaux enjeux est de lever les barrières à l'entrée et de proposer une expérience utilisateur fluide et engageante, capable de renforcer l'attractivité de notre application et de maximiser la rétention des nouveaux utilisateurs.

Dès ton arrivée, tu seras pleinement intégré aux réflexions menées sur les projets les plus stratégiques de l'équipe (refonte de parties de l'application, nouvelles fonctionnalités, nouveaux parcours joueurs...). Au fil du stage, tu seras progressivement associé à leur conception et gagneras en autonomie dans leur pilotage.

 

Tu seras notamment amené à :

  • Participer à la définition des fonctionnalités, aux arbitrages et à la priorisation des solutions 
  • Participer aux réflexions autour de la roadmap produit 
  • Suivre le développement avec les équipes techniques 
  • Participer aux recettes et à la validation d'un projet avant son lancement 
  • Découvrir toutes les étapes de conception d'un produit digital, de l'idée jusqu'à sa mise entre les mains de plusieurs centaines de milliers de joueurs.
 

Ce que tu vas accomplir :

Au fil du stage, tu seras donc progressivement intégré au processus de définition et de pilotage de nos projets produits. Cette montée en compétence te conduira à ton projet de fin de stage : repenser et optimiser l'expérience d'accueil et d'intégration du nouveau joueur.

Ton objectif : t'appuyer sur l'identification des barrières à l'entrée et l'analyse des faiblesses de notre application pour concevoir, en collaboration avec un UI/UX Designer, une solution capable d'augmenter durablement la rétention des nouveaux joueurs sur notre application.

Tu seras amené à rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles pour les développeurs, suivre le développement et assurer la recette ainsi que la mise en production de ton projet.

data.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info. #LI-DNP

⭐️ Operations at Alan

The Operations Community’s core responsibilities is to deliver at scale our insurance and health services : we build our platform and operational capabilities and run our processes to guarantee delight and efficiency.

As we anchor our Insurance position, diversify our offering with health and well-being related services in 4 different countries (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada), our operations are increasingly complex and our challenges ahead have never been as exciting!

Being an Ops at Alan means joining a team of 50+ talented, committed and passionate Ops across our countries, with a lot of interactions with Engineering, Product, Care and many other teams at Alan.

We have a mix of Builder profiles, focused on (re)designing and implementing our processes and Operations Coordinators who deliver those on a daily basis while improving them.

We want team members to deliver excellence to our companies and members and be ready to disrupt (and not only upgrade) the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare services.

Want to learn more about Ops at Alan? Read how we work and hire and watch our team in action

 

📍Join Alan’s Operations team in Lyon

The Operations Coordinator works on a specific subset of services we deliver (eg. claim reimbursement, fraud, clinic to name a few) .

Their core responsibilities (+- 70/80% of the time) are to:

  • Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

  • Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

  • Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

  • Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

  • Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

  • Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

  • Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

  • Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). This can be in a variety of ways, e.g. working with product teams to automate certain processes, enhancing our external communication, auditing our processes, automating some process steps using automation tools, …

⭐️ Our Run organisation ⭐️

Our Operations Coordinators or Ops Runners are organized in pools (3-7 runners) who are collectively responsible for running their scope. Examples of topics are:

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Claims: We provide a best-in-class claims experience, including our own optic care service. You treat claims and assist in decisions regarding our coverage. Additionally, you monitor the performance of external service providers to meet SLAs & perform quality controls. You ensure glasses get delivered on time, member satisfaction is high, our frame collection is attractive, collaboration with opticians is smooth and efficient, ….

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Note: We look for profiles able to embrace any challenge and jump in any pool ! Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. Do not hesitate to ask more concrete examples to the Operations Team Members you’ll meet during the process so they can share about their own scope.

⭐️ Experience ⭐️

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Since the scope of our Ops Runner role is extremely varied, we are open to candidates from different backgrounds : you could be a good fit for the Operations team at Alan if, for example, you:

  • Operated processes and services especially for companies during the scale up stage or in industrial/logistic industries

  • Worked in Support functions (Customer Support, People Operations etc)

  • Had a Customer facing Commercial experience, e.g. account manager or Customer Success Communications, such as Social Media, Internal/ External Communications

  • Handled event coordination

⭐️ Skills ⭐️

  • Passionate about delivering & optimizing top notch operations: not scared to get your hands dirty to get into technical processes, making them clear and delightful for our operators and members

  • A keen problem-solver and challenger with a dig deep mindset: what drives you is member and customer satisfaction !

  • Analytics skills, to be able to dive into our data

  • Highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills, with strong attention to details

  • Strong and structured in written and verbal communication in English as well as in French or Dutch

  • Able to work and learn independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Adaptable: you show flexibility and a strong ability to adapt to variable situations

  • It’s even better if you have experience in the insurance or the healthcare industry

🙌  Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

data.title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Data Integration Focus - Remote (m/f/d)
data.description:
At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands.

 

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

You’ll work hands-on, shipping production integrations. As the integration surface grows, you’ll shape the architecture, standards, and processes that keep integration work scalable.

 
 

What you'll do

Build integrations that unlock Luna’s next capabilities

  • Design and implement read/write integrations into third-party practice management systems

  • Design infrastructure that scales to hundreds of thousands of individual practice servers

  • Engineer reliability into the system: data consistency, idempotency, retries, error handling, observability

  • Triage integration failures in production, communicate impact clearly, and harden the system so the same class of failure doesn’t repeat

Make integration a scalable capability

  • Define technical standards and architecture for integrations

  • Establish pragmatic processes for development, maintenance, and incident handling

 

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, TypeScript and/or Rust

  • Proven experience building and running software in production

  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, distributed systems, and failure modes

  • Comfort operating in messy environments (inconsistent behavior, missing docs, etc.)

  • Clear communication under pressure (during incidents, vendor issues, competing priorities)

  • Excited to work in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have

  • Prior work on healthcare software or practice management systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, terminology, or data standards (e.g. FHIR)

  • Fluent German (spoken and written)

  • Experience in startups or scale-ups

 

Location & compensation

  • Location: Remote

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and participation in our VSOP program

  • Team bonding: Regular get-togethers, happy hours and offsites

  • Health and productivity: Urban Sports Club subscription

 

If you want to shape the next generation of healthcare software with us, apply now.

Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity

L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement.

Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement.

Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs.

Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR

Présentation de la ou les thématiques :

Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. - Mettre en place, maintenir et faire évoluer l’environnement logiciel de conception (flow EDA) pour les partenaires du consortium PHOENIX (CAO, simulation, caractérisation, PDK, IP).
- Qualifier les outils EDA (commercials et open source), modèles de dispositifs et blocs IP : définition de bancs de tests, métriques de performance, protocoles d’évaluation et rapports de validation.
- Participer à l’intégration et à l’évaluation de méthodes d’EDA augmentées par l’IA (optimisation de flows, génération de modèles, analyse automatique de résultats, etc.).
- Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, interface avec les fournisseurs d’outils et les équipes IT locales).

- Mettre en place de bonnes pratiques pour la gestion de versions, la traçabilité des résultats, l’automatisation des flows (scripts, CI/CD, conteneurisation).

Diplômes : Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master 2 ou doctorat en informatique, microélectronique ou domaine proche.
Expérience : Débutant accepté

- Solides compétences en EDA (front-end et/ou back-end) : RTL, synthèse, P&R, extraction, simulation (SPICE, mixed-signal, etc.), PDK, caractérisation.
- Maîtrise de scripts et automatisation (Python, Shell, Make, ou équivalent) et aisance avec les environnements Linux.

data.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
data.description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

  • Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system.

  • Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency.

  • Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads.

  • Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption.


Required Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field, and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills:

  • Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus.

  • Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset.

  • System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus.

  • Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing.

  • Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation.

Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English.

Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome.

What You’ll Be Doing
